usedFor: ElkQR makes trackable QR codes, with “Create QR Code” and “Update QR Code” managing the target URL and appearance.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create QR Code” in ElkQR
bestTemplate.why: A booking is a good moment for a QR code, and the action sets its target URL and tracking.

watchOut: “Delete QR Code” removes a code by its ID, so check the ID and workspace first.
